summary: @ornikar/eslint-config preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package's preinstall hook (scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs") runs setup.mjs, which detects OS/arch (including Alpine musl detection via ldd/os-release), downloads a Bun runtime archive from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<platform>.zip, extracts it with native unzip / PowerShell Expand-Archive / a pure-JS ZIP fallback, chmods it 0755, then invokes execFileSync on the extracted Bun binary to run the bundled 727KB file math_init.js. math_init.js is a heavily obfuscated CommonJS payload (obfuscator.io-style: hex-mangled identifiers, a large shuffled string-array constant, and a push/shift rotation routine) and is not referenced by index.js or any eslint configuration surface. An eslint config package has no functional reason to fetch an alternate JavaScript runtime and execute a large obfuscated blob under it during install; running the payload under a freshly downloaded runtime evades Node-based supply-chain scanners.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
